overview: Black declines the gambit with 2...Nf6 and White chooses between 3.fxe5 Nxe4 (Wade Variation) and 3.Nf3, transposing to a Petrov with f4 included. After 3.fxe5 Nxe4 4.Nf3 Be7 White has a pawn on e5 for a possibly weakened king and Black can aim for ...d5 and ...O-O. The game is open and somewhat double-edged for White's king, though it is not a gambit as no material changes hands.

white_ideas.idea: fxe5 and Nf3, d4 and Bd3 with central space.
Use the half-open f-file and develop quickly.

black_ideas.idea: ...Nxe4 and ...Be7 with ...d5 and quick castling, hitting e5.
Exploit White's weakened king diagonal e1-h4.

typical_structures.structure: Open e-file with White pawn on e5 attacked, or a normal e4/e5 centre after 3.Nf3.
